runtimeConclusion: Full pose swaps can provide the observed occlusion and silhouette changes. Mesh deformation alone cannot reveal the new back-facing torso or newly extended arm artwork. Fixed feet/sockets and secondary mesh motion preserve integration. Reference displacement and timings are not copied; work-order envelopes stay authoritative.
